source_ref: cross_g4_01..24 from place-geo and m2c-line-names; profiles from m2c-lines-v1

decisions.boundary_rule: Split only at consecutive trace-run changes in surface, waterbody_ref, movement_class, or movement_method_id, as A-routes-b2-01 authorizes; trace geometry bends and travel_band changes alone do not split.
decisions.minutes: Each direction total equals place-geo proposed_minutes. Multi-segment totals allocated from unrounded trace duration weights using floor + largest fractional remainder; ties by stable group key.

waterbody_line_kind_mapping.basis: authored world-map waterbody classification; central_head_branch follows reviewer A-routes-b2-01 and wave-1 approval-attestation limit 7; editorial hypothesis for Opus.

decisions.segment_labels: Reuse m2c-line-names world-route name on constituent segments; no segment invents a toponym.
assumptions_for_opus: central_head_branch uses lkp__side_channel@1 by reviewer A-routes-b2-01 / wave-1 approval-attestation limit 7; line-names remains river_channel for cross_g4_06..08 and must be separately corrected by its owner.
All non-main authored waterbody refs map to side_channel; this is an editorial mapping in schematic place-geo geometry, not a historical claim about 1230.
Place-geo minutes are draft calibration values; cross_g4_10 (741 minutes each way) requires plausibility review.
Hazard swim_* refs have no underlying records; safe/passable is unresolved. Water routes lack winter ice data.
decisions.import_policy: Candidate only. Import only together with the b2 runtime reader cutover. No bootstrap import.
